text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a coincidence to encounter
familiar
faces here. Have you come to
offer up your
prayers?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, good day to you too. We came on

volunteer duty to clean the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Cleaning was exceptionally fun! You
should have
offered to clean too,
Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's right. By the way, what brings you
here?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The specialty tea shop I go to is close
by. I was on
my way back from
purchasing some things.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I would love to treat you all to a cup,
but I've yet
to mix anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you preparing your own brew?
That's
wonderful... I would certainly love
to have some.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, are three willing test subjects
actually
knocking at my door? Excellent,
I would gladly
treat you all!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... I actually already have a
mixture prepared back at the academy. I
can begin
brewing it the moment we
return.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I haven't had a tea party in so
long! I look
forward to receiving your
invitation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, there's no need for such
formalities, especially if the tea party
takes place at the academy. So long as
we exchange contact
information...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it... maybe I should print out a list of precautions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I would also prefer knowing your health

conditions ahead of time. I'll prepare a
few
questions.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Our health conditions?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Thank you for being so
thoughtful.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm only doing what is necessary,
considering what you might experience
after the tea. Does the mention of
potential numbing cause you any
alarm?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Numbing?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any allergies to speak of!
And I will not be needing a taste tester
either. I love my tea
like I love my
ramen—piping hot! ☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha, fret not! You may lose the
ability to
contain your laughter, but that
won't be the fault
of any poison per se.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, a tea party of endless laughter...
It seems
we're all in for a very wonderful
time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(What's going on? I don't think we're on
the same
page anymore!)
